correctness.rationale: Exact slice integrals give A,X,Y with correct uniform-volume covariance normalization. The symbolic derivative is -4 a P(theta)/(9 sin(theta) A^5). Product-to-sum identities, 44th-degree Taylor polynomial and exact rational derivative/remainder inequalities prove P(theta)<0 on all 0<theta<pi/2, hence strict increasing for every 0<a<1. Affine-rescaled lenses converge to full-dimensional parabolic lens and beta moments yield 9/1400. Symbolic and numerical checker executed from the actual package directory and passed 150 assertions, including exact-rational continuum sign certification; finite quadrature is only independent cross-check. Boundary a=0 and unattained a=1 are treated explicitly.

Its ratio monotonicity does not imply monotonicity of det(Cov)/area^2, since both eigenvalues and area vary. The nearest planar Mahler note concerns polar area and its reverse monotonicity, not the covariance determinant. value.rationale: A complete strict ordering on the natural, continuously varying family of intersections of two congruent disks under a canonical affine-invariant second-moment functional, with an exact sharp endpoint and a concrete parabolic limiting body. The key challenge is competing variation of two principal moments and shrinking area; the result is stronger than previously known anisotropy or Mahler monotonicity for this family, and is useful as a sharp benchmark for lens shape interpolation and affine-invariant geometry. No unmotivated slice, routine normalization or claimed general convex-body theorem.
